title: Cracked earth and salt flat
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of dried mud and desert pans: Voronoi plates with open cracks and curled edges, finer secondary cracks, damp patches, or raised salt-crust ridges. Use for deserts, dry lakes and drought scenes.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python cracked_earth.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: crack_width
parameters.meaning: Crack (or ridge) width in plate widths.

parameters.name: edge_relief
parameters.meaning: Border profile: negative opens cracks with curled plate edges, positive raises salt ridges.

parameters.name: curl
parameters.meaning: How far plate edges lift beside the cracks.

parameters.name: secondary_cracks
parameters.meaning: Shallow finer cracks inside the plates.

parameters.name: moisture
parameters.meaning: Damp darkening and lower roughness in patches.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Dry tan clay plates with open cracks and curled edges.

presets.name: dark_mud
presets.description: Dark drying mud with narrow cracks and damp patches.

presets.name: desert_pan
presets.description: Pale desert pan with wide cracks and many small plates.

presets.name: salt_flat
presets.description: White salt crust in polygons with raised ridges.

limits: Plates are Voronoi cells, which give mostly polygonal outlines; real shrinkage cracks also meet at right angles. Curl and ridges are height profiles only. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Worley noise cells as shrinkage plates
Noise-modulated crack width from the distance to the cell border
Second, finer Worley diagram for secondary cracks
Signed edge profile for cracks or ridges
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
